summary: Join our Community-Based Tourism Development Training Course to learn strategies for sustainable tourism that enrich communities and foster cultural exchange.
lede: Community-based tourism development helps residents shape visitor experiences, local benefits, cultural safeguards, and environmental limits. For practitioners who plan, coordinate, finance, operate, or evaluate tourism initiatives, the course provides a structured way to assess opportunities and prepare a feasible development plan. Learners practise community asset and value-chain analysis, design inclusive governance and visitor-capacity measures, and select indicators to track livelihood and conservation outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, coordinate, finance, operate, or evaluate tourism initiatives with meaningful community participation. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who already work with destinations, visitor services, local enterprises, cultural assets, conservation activities, or community development programmes.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to tourism planning, destination operations, community development, hospitality, conservation, cultural heritage, or local enterprise support. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet literacy helps you complete the Excel indicator exercise, but templates and a structured dataset are provided. Advanced digital topics, including AI-assisted visitor research and automated monitoring, receive operational application treatment rather than technical engineering depth.
